# Order with Seller Decision

Adds a seller rejection decision to an Order with Clauses. The rejection record at `/orderDecision/status` starts as PENDING. Approval comes from the configured Activation workflow.

Only the seller can submit `rejectOrder`. The connection requires the exact reviewed Order version and the action checks the current activation revision. Seller approval or a stale revision closes the rejection route. A successful rejection records REJECTED together with the reviewed revision and terms reference and emits Order rejected. A repeated rejection after the same guards pass leaves the record fixed.

The Order's dispatch policy blocks external activation operations after seller rejection. The configured `/clauses/orderDecision/parameters/activationOperations` list adds operation names to that check. Reservation or later cancellation effects depend on the independently configured clauses.
